fields.name: ShapeshiftState
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x34F9960 (applies an EquipmentSetRequest) creates the component (storage bg3.exe+0x2701B60, size 0x10, zeroed) on every item it adds when the request's ShapeshiftState Guid (param_6 = request+0x18) is non-zero, and copies those 16 bytes into it. bg3.exe+0x34F7990 (shapeshift equipment history) compares both qwords of the component with an entry of esv::inventory::ShapeshiftEquipmentHistoryComponent.History (Array<Guid>) and removes the component on a match. The savegame loader bg3.exe+0x25C1AC0 copies 16-byte elements of ls::model::game::inventory::v0::ShapeshiftAddedEquipmentComponent into it.

open_questions: Never alive in the captures (needs a shapeshift that adds equipment).
